title: BlogIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: blog.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Blog server/domain/publication.js syncIndex, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks indexEvent). The OpenVibe.Search document of a published, public, listable post, sent whenever what Search should hold changed (the revision grows with every change). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: post, id, revision: <document revision> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:blog.
